ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to <image1> “Development and Evolution Model Diagram of a Typical Hollowed-out Village in the Urban-Rural Fringe,” what does residential land change rate curve c in the figure represent?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is time, the vertical axis is residential land change rate, and three curves a, b, and c change over time. Curve c is above the horizontal axis in the early stage of evolution, showing obvious positive growth and reaching a relatively high value; afterward it gradually declines, crosses the zero-growth line and enters the negative-growth area, and later rises somewhat again. Reasoning: The question stem states that in urban-rural transformation, “newly built housing continuously expands outward,” so residential land on the village periphery will grow obviously in the early stage because of the outward expansion of newly built housing; curve c in the figure exactly fits this characteristic of early expansion and later decline in change rate. Therefore c represents the village periphery.

raw_record.question_text: According to <image1> “Development and Evolution Model Diagram of a Typical Hollowed-out Village in the Urban-Rural Fringe,” what does residential land change rate curve c in the figure represent?

method.method_draft: 读取题干要求判断 c 曲线表示的位置。先描述图像中 c 曲线的形态：它在时间演化前期表现为明显正增长，之后下降并出现负增长。再结合题干关于“新建住房不断向外围扩展”的说明，判断这种前期扩张特征最符合村庄周边宅基地的变化，因此 c 表示村周边。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中横轴为时间，纵轴为宅基地变化率，a、b、c 三条曲线随时间变化。c 曲线在演化前期位于横轴以上，表现为明显正增长，并达到较高值；随后逐渐下降，穿过零增长线后进入负增长区，后期又有所回升。推理：题干说明城乡转型中“新建住房不断向外围扩展”，因此村庄周边宅基地在前期会因新建住房外扩而增长明显；图中 c 曲线正符合这种前期扩张、之后变化率下降的特征。所以 c 表示村周边。
